title: A CEO Earns Your Year's Pay In 1.3 Days
hook: A CEO can earn a worker's yearly pay in 1.3 days.
closing: That speed explains why ordinary raises feel so small.
question: Does this pay gap feel defensible?

segments.say: CEO compensation reached 281 times typical worker pay, widening the distance at the top.
CEO pay climbed 1,085 percent, while worker compensation barely moved.
A CEO earns a typical worker's yearly pay in about 1.3 days.
